Notes

要钱没有烂命一条

The defiant formula 要钱没有，要命一条 offers a life when there is no money to hand over. Adding 烂, “rotten” or “worthless,” makes even that last stake sound devalued. It is both self-dismissal and a refusal to be intimidated.

  • Genius community lyric text
当面一套背后一套

Literally one set in front of someone and another behind their back: a familiar accusation of hypocrisy. 套 refers to a whole pattern of behavior, connecting this complaint with the album’s recurring distrust of 套路, practiced routines or tricks.

  • Genius community lyric text
饼画大点再大点

画饼 (“draw a pie”) means holding out attractive promises that may never materialize. Saying he still has not eaten turns that empty promise back into literal food.

  • Genius community lyric text
宝子

宝子 is an affectionate, informal address derived from 宝贝, “darling.” Dropped into the request for ever bigger empty promises, it makes the encouragement sound teasing or sarcastic rather than sincerely trusting.

  • Genius community lyric text
crack rn

The community source gives “crack rn” in the mixed-language line. Its intended grammar and sense are unclear, so the draft retains it rather than inventing a correction.

  • Genius community lyric text
屌

屌 is a vulgar anatomical word that also works as slang for impressive, formidable, or awesome. Here it praises his own style. Translating the anatomical meaning literally would miss the boast, while “good” alone would lose its register.

  • Genius community lyric text
给你脸

给脸 means showing someone respect or giving them room to behave honorably. Saying they refuse it is an insult: they have rejected the consideration offered.

  • Genius community lyric text
朋友圈

Literally “circle of friends,” this is WeChat’s social feed, commonly called Moments in English. His feed and contact list become the stage for the final exaggerated announcement.

  • Genius community lyric text
俗人贪财好色

俗人 places the speaker among worldly, ordinary people rather than someone above material desires. 贪财好色 openly embraces two conventionally criticized appetites, money and sex. After the advice about sleep, food, and staying alive, the line makes pleasure an unapologetic small-scale life philosophy.

  • Genius community lyric text
平均半小时一首歌

The boast fits his account of writing in response to beats: in i-D he describes ordinary life as inspiration and says the beat prompts what he writes. That gives context for the casual recording scene, without treating “half an hour” as a verified production average.

  • Genius community lyric text
  • Jackzebra interviewed by i-D
鬼哭狼嚎

鬼哭狼嚎 is a set expression for terrible wailing or howling, literally ghosts crying and wolves howling. Applying it to his own late-night recording makes the claim that music is easy self-mocking as well as boastful.

  • Genius community lyric text
又一幺幺六杰泽比

The source spells this phonetically. In this guest lineup it appears to name Yoyi, “one-one-six” (User116), and Jackzebra. 幺 is a spoken form of the digit one. This identification remains an interpretation.

  • Genius community lyric text
我微信222个人全部都死了

User116 has just valued good food, attractive contacts, and being alive. Jackzebra then turns the same social world into an exaggerated death announcement, including himself. The abrupt reversal makes the song’s repeated “life” unstable: ordinary enjoyment and total dismissal coexist.

  • Genius community lyric text
